name: Sinopia
description: Slides and vector documents: a ribbon, a slide sorter, an outline, transitions and a slide show.

capabilities.files: Saves and opens your decks, and exports them as PDF or PNG, where you choose.
capabilities.windows: Shows the slide show to the audience in a window of its own, on a second display.
capabilities.assistant: Changes your slides when you ask, with the assistant you set up in Settings.
